comment: Frozen services-layer dependency edges - S1 initial baseline (runs/split ruling 2 of 2026-10-16; all 14 import statements re-verified line-by-line against the worktree at landing, 2026-10-24). Entries enumerate concrete edges src_file+dst_module (A-3 granularity); 'line' is provenance from the 2026-10-16 AST snapshot, matching is by src_file+dst_module so line drift never false-alarms. domain_pair is the grouping view used by module-map section 2b edge column (I-3, bidirectional reconciliation). kind: cross-domain = S1b exemption; layer = S1a exemption (only #13, the reverse dependency). Ratchet: only-shrink - adding an entry is a RED LINE (constraints.md, ask first), removing is free and expected (KPI: count -> 0). A cycle whose edges are all in this list = WARN on the per-entry 90-day clock (A-9 / A6 paradigm); an edge present in code but absent here = ERROR. Batch 1 (2026-10-24, P-037): 15 -> 12 entries - pdf_raster registered as the first shared leaf (P-038) dissolved kie->infra and document->infra; single_file_pipeline moved up into orchestration/ (ruling-2 'pipeline up' inversion) dissolved pipeline->L2.
